hooks/codex-hooks.json: Codex SessionStart hook registration, named in .codex-plugin/plugin.json. It passes codex so the text names Codex tools. Codex runs it only after the user trusts it, and an edit to its command or matcher voids that trust.
hooks/hooks.json: Claude SessionStart and PreToolUse hook registration. Codex reads hooks/codex-hooks.json instead. T3 has no Custom Modes to keep poteto-mode in context.
hooks/pre-bash: Blocks a Claude Bash call that waits in a foreground until or while loop, which holds back subagent wakes, and one that zsh always aborts: an unquoted glob in an option value or a word that starts with ===. Session reviews counted thousands of each, after the adapter and the session-start text already named them.
hooks/session-start: Gives Claude and Codex sessions the plugin path, a reminder to apply poteto-mode that a delegated child skips unless its brief asks for it, and the read-by-path rule for typed-only skills. Upstream dropped poteto-mode's reminder key because Cursor ignored it, so the hook carries the text.
README.md: No Claude Code install section. Upstream's installs Cursor's own Claude Code tree, and its adapter link points at docs/harness, which this port does not ship. The T3 adapter replaces it.
skills/poteto-mode/references/t3-adapter: Maps every Cursor mechanic the skills name to T3 Code for Claude and Codex.
skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md: One line pointing at the T3 adapter.
skills/poteto-mode/scripts/worktree-audi: Finds the last chat per worktree in Claude and Codex transcripts instead of Cursor's agent-transcripts.
skills/poteto-help/SKILL.md: T3 install steps, the ~/.agents model sheet, and no Custom Mode, cloud agent, or make-bot-ui advice.
skills/setup-pstack/SKILL.md: Detects models with orchestrator_capabilities and writes ~/.agents/pstack-models.md with T3 descriptors instead of a Cursor rule.
docs/guide/01-setup.md: No Claude Code install paragraph. It installs Cursor's own Claude Code tree and links docs/harness, which this port does not ship.
